meta.title: Sluneční Dvůr — honest cooking in Milčeves
meta.description: For a hearty lunch, an evening with friends, a wedding or a family celebration. Sluneční Dvůr restaurant, Milčeves 55 near Žatec. Menu, photos and reservations.
meta.galleryTitle: Photos from the courtyard | Sluneční Dvůr

hero.eyebrow: MILČEVES NEAR ŽATEC · RESTAURANT AND COURTYARD
hero.text:
For a hearty lunch. For time together.
For a place you’ll love coming back to.
hero.location: Near Žatec, where it’s easy to unwind.

story.title: Food that speaks for itself.
story.text: Honest home cooking, a generous plate and time for each other. That’s just how we like it at Sluneční Dvůr.
story.text2: Stop by in Milčeves. For lunch, for something delicious or simply to spend time with people who make you feel at home.
story.caption: From our kitchen straight to your table.
story.signature: We look forward to welcoming you to the courtyard.

menu.eyebrow: WHAT WE’RE BRINGING TO THE TABLE
menu.title:
Good food.
Generous portions.
menu.intro: There’s something for everyone in our kitchen. From hot soup and schnitzels to Czech and Slovak specialties.
menu.pageIntro: Choose whatever takes your fancy. We’ll take care of the rest.
menu.allergenInfo: Allergen numbers are taken from the printed menu. Where none are listed, this does not mean the dish is free from allergens. Our staff will be happy to help you choose.
menu.priceNote: Prices are in CZK. Please ask our staff about current dish availability.

legal.privacyText: This website has no contact form or analytics. When booking by phone, please provide only the details needed to prepare your table. If you have questions about how your data is processed, please contact us by phone.
legal.externalText: Links to Facebook, Instagram and maps lead to external services with their own privacy policies. The embedded Google map loads only when you request it.
legal.cookiesText: The website itself does not store analytics or advertising cookies. It only keeps a record in the current tab’s memory of whether the opening animation has already been shown. The hosting service may use essential cookies to provide access to a private preview.

garden.title: Good food starts in the garden.
garden.text: We grow our own tomatoes, crisp salad leaves, cucumbers and other vegetables right here. Whatever is ripening in the garden helps shape what we cook.
garden.more: Take a look around the garden

occasions.title:
For all the moments
that bring us together.
occasions.intro: Sometimes all you need is a table for two. Other times, you want the whole family or your friends around you. There’s room here for those shared moments, too – including the biggest one, your wedding.
occasions.photoCaption: The table is set for your gathering.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.text: We host weddings, too. We’ll prepare the wedding feast with honest home cooking and festively set tables, just the way you imagine it.

celebrations.title: Family celebrations
celebrations.text: A special lunch or a gathering for the whole family. Together at one table, with good food.

birthdays.title: Birthdays
birthdays.text: Reasons to celebrate, big and small. Bring your loved ones and enjoy the day together.

events.title: Events & gatherings
events.text: A catch-up with friends or a group event. A place for good food and good conversation.

occasions.note: We’ll be happy to discuss the date, number of guests and your ideas in person.

stay.title: Why not stay the night?
stay.text: Combine a visit to the restaurant with a stay at the farmstead. You’ll find accommodation options and booking information on the Gut Sonnenhof website.

careers.title:
We’re looking
for a cook.
careers.intro: Do you love cooking good, honest food? Join us in Milčeves, near Žatec. We cook Czech and international dishes, with room for your experience and your own ideas.
careers.details: What we offer and who we’re looking for
offers: Room for your creativity and ideas
requires: The ability to work independently and responsibly
Enthusiasm for work and learning new things
careers.posterAlt: Sluneční Dvůr job advert: we’re looking for a cook. Job details and contact information appear beside the image.
